retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century modern layout featuring a high-contrast portrait against a complex geometric op-art background with a distinct top-aligned information header.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into a top information bar and a large lower portrait area. The background is a distorted, wavy red and black checkerboard pattern that creates a sense of depth and movement. A side-profile portrait of a woman is centered, lit with warm tones. The top section contains structured columns of text and a primary title block in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy typographic header vs. large-scale portrait subject
Wavy geometric background pattern vs. smooth organic facial features
Warm skin tones vs. dark red and black background palette
Right-aligned title block vs. left-aligned tracklist columns
coreInvariants: Horizontal header bar separating text from imagery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close-up profile portrait, centered horizontally and occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary title block in the upper right corner acts as the entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top right title, moves left across the tracklist columns, then drops down to the subject's face and follows the curve of the background pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The background pattern functions as active negative space, providing texture without being empty.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high contrast between the dark background and the illuminated subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely tight kerning where characters nearly touch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin white vertical and horizontal rules to separate text columns

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century Swiss style and tight kerning capabilities.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a distorted red and black checkerboard pattern that creates a wavy, op-art effect. Place a warm-toned profile portrait of a woman in the center foreground. Leave the top 20% of the image as a solid black horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two columns of white sans-serif text in the center of the black bar. In the right side of the black bar, add a large two-line title in a bold geometric sans-serif, with the top line in yellow and the bottom line in white, both in lowercase with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a distorted checkerboard?
Is the top header bar solid black?
Is the main title in lowercase sans-serif?
Are there thin white lines separating the text columns?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist names or existing album titles
Do not replicate the specific record label logo in the top left

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subject and pattern

postGenerationChecks: Check that the checkerboard pattern is wavy and not a flat grid
Ensure the text in the header is perfectly aligned to the grid
Verify the portrait has a soft, vintage film-like grain
Confirm the title text is lowercase and tightly tracked
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Pattern Background + Solid Header Bar + Tight Sans-Serif Typography + Warm Profile Portrait
